nodes.name: Build portrait resolver
nodes.prompt: Project: WoW addon Quest Sharing in /Users/cozzolif/Desktop/cutpdf (read context/architecture.md and the section '## Bosses fix (2026-11-20)' of context/dungeon-journal-contract.md; Dungeon Journal at /tmp/dj_addon is INSPIRATION ONLY, never copy its code, data or media; Lua 5.1; tests are plain scripts run with /tmp/qs-test-env/bin/python). Problem: 59 official bosses (all of the 9 WoW Forever dungeons plus Ezra Grimm) have neither ejFile nor displayID in QuestSharing/DungeonBossData.lua, so the Bosses page shows a muted skull. Their display IDs are not public (Wowhead /forever/ pages are blocked), but the client knows them. You own ONLY QuestSharing/BossPortraitResolver.lua (stub exists: R.displayFor(npcID), R.request(npcID, done)), QuestSharing/DungeonBossesUI.lua and the new tests/test_boss_portrait_resolver.py. Build: one hidden PlayerModel (1x1, alpha 0, parented to UIParent, created lazily), a FIFO queue, one lookup at a time: SetCreature(npcID), then read GetDisplayInfo() on OnModelLoaded or after a short timer (0.2 s, up to 5 tries, then give up for this session), never in combat (InCombatLockdown) or during a loading screen (pause on PLAYER_LEAVING_WORLD, resume on PLAYER_ENTERING_WORLD). A display ID of 0 or nil means not known. Cache results in ns.db.bossDisplays[npcID] (create the table in ns.db lazily; QuestSharingDB is the saved variable) and in a session table for failures. In DungeonBossesUI.lua B.portrait: when a boss has no ejFile/by-name art and no displayID, use R.displayFor(npcID); if nil, show the muted skull now and call R.request(npcID, done) so done repaints that row/header through the existing staged display path (respect the page token: ignore when the page changed or is hidden). Request only for bosses of the dungeon being shown, at most 12 queued at a time. Add '/qs bossdump' that prints the cached ids as 'npcID=displayID' lines (for baking later). Mock tests: queue order, one at a time, combat/loading pause, OnModelLoaded and timer paths, give-up after 5 tries, cache in ns.db, repaint on success, stale page ignored, no lookups when every boss has art. Run your test file plus tests/test_dungeon_journal_bosses.py, tests/test_dungeon_journal_bosses_ui.py, tests/test_dungeon_quests.py. Report {files, summary, tests, notes}.
